title: Covenant of circumcision; Abram renamed Abraham
summary: God makes the covenant of circumcision with Abraham, aged 99, and promises Isaac (Gen 17).
description: God appeared to Abram at 99, renamed him Abraham and Sarai Sarah, gave the sign of circumcision, and promised that Sarah would bear Isaac "at this set time in the next year" (Gen 17:1-21).
